ai_summary: Aries Agro Limited's 56th Annual General Meeting adopted the FY2026 financial statements and declared a significant Rs. 2.50 per share total dividend (25%), including a special dividend, indicating a positive return for shareholders. Key leadership continuity was ensured with the re-appointment of the Managing Director and an Independent Director. However, the approval of a commission payment to Ms. Nitya Mirchandani, a Promoter Director, through a special resolution, may warrant further scrutiny as a related-party compensation.
